what: NVIDIA GEAR-SONIC whole-body controller (Unitree G1) in closed loop, MuJoCo sim2sim on an RTX 5090 desktop, with the upstream C++/TensorRT deploy. Reference machine for the Jetson records (runs v1_r1..v1_r3).

what_ran.upstream: NVlabs/GR00T-WholeBodyControl @ b042411fae38ee4d1af9aac82a37a1f8d14d6dd0 (2026-09-23), gear_sonic_deploy g1_deploy_onnx_ref (C++ + TensorRT), unmodified except the measurement probe (per-tick timestamps + tensor copies into preallocated memory, written at exit; no I/O in the loop). These runs used the probe without the planner-I/O capture that sonic/harness/sonic_probe.hpp adds (SonicPlannerIO, a memcpy in the planner thread after inference returns); the per-tick record and span are identical.

trt_engines.precision: all three fp32 builds (upstream defaults: encoder use_fp16=false in obs config; --policy-precision/--planner-precision default 32); upstream builder does not clear TF32, so TRT's default TF32 permission applies
trt_engines.built_once: engines built by upstream code on first (smoke) launch and reused unchanged by all 3 measured runs (same-build; TRT build variance across builds NOT sampled)

stack.power_regime: dynamic: default driver boost, GPU clocks NOT locked, host CPU governor default (the Jetsons were pinned)
stack.container: nvidia/cuda:12.9.1-devel-ubuntu22.04 + the upstream install_deps apt list (no ROS2), onnxruntime 1.16.3 (sonic/harness/Dockerfile); run with --user, so the deploy is non-root and its SCHED_FIFO request fails silently
stack.tensorrt: 10.13.0.35 (TensorRT-10.13.0.35.Linux.x86_64-gnu.cuda-12.9 tar; the version upstream docs REQUIRE for x86)
stack.deploy_flags: lo policy/release/model_decoder.onnx reference/example/ --obs-config policy/release/observation_config.yaml --encoder-file policy/release/model_encoder.onnx --planner-file planner/target_vel/V2/planner_sonic.onnx --input-type keyboard --output-type zmq --zmq-host localhost --disable-crc-check (identical on all three machines)

sim.what: upstream gear_sonic MuJoCo BaseSimulator (scene_43dof.xml, 200 Hz, elastic band, unitree_sdk2py DDS bridge on lo), mujoco 3.15.0, headless (ENABLE_ONSCREEN False) via sonic/harness/sim_driver.py (SIM_POLL_CMDS unset: upstream DDS listener)
sim.deviation_pacing: upstream rate limiter sleep(dt - elapsed) accumulates sleep overshoot; an uncontrolled smoke check of it ran ~0.82x real time (821 steps in a 5 s window, 1 observation) while the C++ controller runs on wall clock. sim_driver.py paces to absolute deadlines instead: measured RTF 1.00000 in all 3 runs, 0 overrun steps.
sim.band_drop: upstream 'press 9 in viewer' replaced by a scripted band_off on the sim's stdin 2 s after control start

what_ran.command_script: fixed keyboard script on the deploy's stdin (sonic/harness/run_closed_loop_x86.py SCRIPTS['v1']): ']' start; +2 s drop; +7 ENTER planner; +10 walk(2)+W; +18..19 Q x3 (turn facing 3 x pi/6) + W; +25 run(3)+W; +31 R stop; +36 slow walk(1)+W; +41 R; +45 ENTER back to reference mode; +47 select macarena_001__A545 (n presses from load order); +49 T play clip (1375 frames, 27.5 s); +82 O exit. Identical across runs and reusable on other boards.

preregistration: predictions written before any measured run and before reading any latency output; two stand-only smoke runs (debugging motion files and the probe) were seen first (smoke step p50 186 us). Predictions were not edited after. Outcomes: prediction_vs_measured.
input_provenance: real: observations generated in closed loop by the upstream controller acting on the upstream MuJoCo G1 simulator, driven by the fixed command script; reference motion = upstream sample clip macarena_001__A545 + planner-generated locomotion. No synthetic tensors.

reference_sets.what: the exact encoder/decoder tensors TensorRT consumed and produced in run v1_r1 (4099 ticks: enc_in [N,1762], enc_out [N,64], dec_in [N,994], dec_out [N,29], float32), and the planner inputs/outputs of 86 planner calls from a separate 5090 planner-logging run (used only as a correctness reference, never for timing). Used by the Jetson engine-correctness gate (A2). Not published (size).
reference_sets.limitation: encoder mode was 0 (g1) on every tick of this script; the teleop (1) and smpl (2) encoder branches were computed but never selected

host_census: per run: load 0.5-1.6 on 32 cores, swap rate 0-1 pages/s, MemAvailable ~87 GB; two idle GPU processes resident (~9.4 GB, GPU util 0-3%)
metric_span: same upstream program (NVlabs/GR00T-WholeBodyControl @ b042411fae38ee4d1af9aac82a37a1f8d14d6dd0 (2026-09-23), gear_sonic_deploy g1_deploy_onnx_ref (C++ + TensorRT)), same measurement probe (sonic/harness/sonic_probe.hpp + sonic_probe.patch), same span: step = obs_start -> after CurrentFrameAdvancement (robot-state gather, observation build, encoder, decoder, hand commands, ZMQ publish, frame advance); late starts / slot misses = raw tick start-to-start gaps > 21 / > 25 ms; compute miss = step > 20 ms; enc_us / dec_us = Encode() / Infer() walls (H2D + enqueue/CUDA graph + D2H + sync); planner_model_ms = upstream last_timing_.model_duration (TensorRT inference only), planner_total_ms = UpdatePlanning wall. The RTX 5090 reference = runs v1_r1..v1_r3.
deadline_rule: compute miss = step > 20 ms; slot miss = start-to-start > 25 ms (late starts > 21 ms: sonic/make_sonic_table.py, from the per-tick log)
reps: 3 identical scripted runs (r1-r3), ~4100 control ticks each; per-run stats + pooled

deadline.headroom: worst step 3.38 ms = 17% of the 20 ms budget (DERIVED)

planner_call_rate_hz.source: planner.bin timestamps, identical in all 3 runs (85 calls each)

behaviour_summary.falls: 0 / 3 runs (no z<0.30 m, no tilt>60 deg, 0 sim auto-resets)
behaviour_summary.turn: yaw 1.6 -> 85.6 deg over the 3 x pi/6 turn command (r1 sim log)
behaviour_summary.reading: upright through stand, walk, 90 deg turn, run, stop, slow walk and a 27.5 s macarena clip in all 3 runs; walk/slow-walk speed within 1-3% of the planner reference root speed; run reaches 1.73-1.75 m/s vs the planner's 2.16-2.22 m/s reference (-20 to -22%), the largest tracking gap (joint err max ~1.1 rad there)

results.per_run_note: per-run step / enc / dec / gap statistics: results/sonic/sonic_same_span_table_2026-10-14.json (rebuilt from the tick logs); per-run phase tracking: results/sonic/raw/rtx5090/<run>__run.json

finding_planner_gpu_contention.what: 214 of the 216 encoder/decoder calls slower than 1 ms across 3 runs (decoder 159/160, encoder 55/56; the 2 exceptions are both in r2) overlapped an in-flight planner inference on the same GPU; these make the decoder p99 ~2.4 ms and max 2.9-3.2 ms; outside planner overlap the decoder p99 is 165-180 us and the step p99 426-512 us
finding_planner_gpu_contention.reading: the 10 Hz planner (2.4 ms per call) and the 50 Hz policy share one GPU with no priority; in the run phase (10 Hz replans) about 1 in 5 control ticks waits for the planner. Harmless here (worst step 3.4 ms of 20 ms).

prediction_vs_measured.dec_us: p50 60-61 in [50,200] HIT; p99 2357-2387 vs <= 500 MISS (planner contention, not anticipated); max 2.88-3.17 ms vs <= 3 ms MISS in r3
prediction_vs_measured.deadline_misses: 0 compute / 0 slot in all runs HIT
prediction_vs_measured.behaviour: 0 falls HIT; joint err mean 0.060-0.091 rad < 0.10 HIT; speed within +/-30% HIT (run -22% is closest to the bound)

traps_found: upstream deploy reference/example/*.csv are git-LFS objects; with a no-LFS clone the C++ loader accepts the 3-line LFS pointer text as a 2-timestep motion ('Loaded ... (2 timesteps)', no error) and control then fails at the first tick
the deploy binary in a container with --user needs /etc/passwd mounted (unitree SDK getpwuid throws)
upstream main() waits with sleep(0.02) on an unsigned-int sleep() = sleep(0): a busy-spin on one core for the whole run (not measured here; matters for a CPU-constrained board)
upstream sim rate limiter runs slower than real time (see sim.deviation_pacing)
3 runs are not bit-identical (dec_out differs r1 vs r2/r3): DDS/thread timing makes the closed loop nondeterministic, so cross-board comparisons must use the logged reference set, not a re-run
caveats: one host, one TensorRT build of each engine; build-to-build variance not sampled
simulator and controller on the same host (no network), so LowState age and DDS latency are loopback values
the RTX 5090 is not a robot computer; it is the reference for the Jetson AGX Orin and AGX Thor records
behaviour metrics are from the simulator's ground-truth state; 3 runs of one script, so 0/3 falls bounds the fall rate only loosely
planner reference speed is the finite difference of the planner motion's root over consecutive frames (DERIVED from the logged reference)
raw: results/sonic/raw/rtx5090/ (per-tick timing, planner calls, per-run simulator record); the same-span table is rebuilt from them by sonic/make_sonic_table.py
follow_up_2026-10-14: 2026-10-14: the band-drop open item was tested with the release delay controlled (results/sonic/sonic_banddrop_controlled_2026-10-14.json, RESULTS.md 8.1): this machine fell too, in 3/18 runs (as did Thor and Orin), with on-time control. Falls are now counted by the D1 rule (any sim fall-reset from the band-off command to the stop); re-scored in the table (falls_d1).
